title: Cartwise Rewards Tier Extensions to Cartwise+ Membership Pauses
content:
The member's Cartwise Rewards tier adds a rewards extension to the Cartwise+ Membership pause allowance.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Days added to the pause allowance |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 10 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 5 |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | 0 |

The tier is the one the member's Cartwise Rewards account shows today.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A member at Cartwise Rewards Diamond: 10 days are added.
- A member at Cartwise Rewards Bronze: 5 days are added.
- A member at Cartwise Rewards Member, or with no rewards account: nothing is added.
